title: How Susceptible are Large Language Models to Ideological Manipulation?

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting open-ended responses to sociopolitical instructions (across topics like crime, economy, gender, immigration, race, and science) and using an LLM evaluator (GPT-4) to classify the responses as left-leaning, right-leaning, or neutral to calculate an ideological bias score. The study also measures bias by administering the Political Compass test to the models.
